evidence.evidence_text: This study introduces ERASMO, a framework designed to fine-tune a pretrained language model on textually encoded tabular data and generate embeddings from the fine-tuned model.
ERASMO employs a textual converter to transform tabular data into a textual format, enabling the language model to process and understand the data more effectively.
Additionally, ERASMO produces contextually rich and structurally representative embeddings through techniques such as random feature sequence shuffling and number verbalization.
